verdict.rationale: Together AI is a hosted inference and training platform, so asking whether its source is readable under an open license is a fair openness question. The evidence does not show that the platform's own source is published under any open license. The GitHub item covers only a client TypeScript SDK and states no license, and hosting open-source models is a different thing from the product's own source being open.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
